question: What is remembered as material cause of the inert and effected?
premises: in inertness, in effected-ness, in separate-tattva-state certainly
as Maya — sometimes only its effect
inference: Maya mothers the inert-effected-separate; sometimes just the effect shows.
plain_english: Then in inertness, in effected-ness, in separate-tattva-state certainly — the material cause is remembered as Maya; sometimes that effect only.
